result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: one audit per twelve months, thirty days' written notice, during business hours, through an independent auditor subject to written confidentiality obligations, with no direct or remote systems access. Section 22.2 retains the required Vendor-cost allocation unless underpayment exceeds 5%. The revisions are confined to correcting the overbroad audit mechanics and preserve the existing protections and commercial intent.
